description: Comptages routiers et piétons 2024 is a dataset listed in Data Toulouse Metropole open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Toulouse Métropole. Données de comptage routier: véhicules, cycles et piétons issus de capteurs IOT gérés par Upcity à différents emplacement de la ville de Toulouse. Données du 13/08/2024 - début du comptage- au 31/12/2024. Coverage: Toulouse Métropole. The portal files it under Transport. Its keywords are pieton, cycliste, voiture, IOT. The portal shows 192,354 records. The portal flags it as a time series. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2026-02-18 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte v2.0 (Etalab). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support cycling and walking network and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-toulouse-metropole-fr-portal.
